angles.angle: Bitcoin's security does not make holding it hands-off: intermediaries can fail, self-custody can feel intimidating, and protecting your holdings takes work.
Calling Bitcoin undervalued does not make it immune to interest rates, investor sentiment, or miners choosing AI instead.
Bitcoin offers an alternative to government-controlled money, but its promise depends on decentralization, security, and active ownership.
Bitcoin can be a yardstick for wealth even while markets treat it as a risky asset.
A Bitcoin standard does not eliminate bank-created credit or intermediary failures; those are different from Bitcoin's underlying monetary rules and security.
